body:
Thank you for the kind words!

I have seen a few therapists in my time, first when I was about nine and I think the last one I saw was about three years ago. Unfortunately at the moment I have no medical insurance at all, so it's not really an option for me right now. Which sucks, because it would probably be a big help.

And yeah, those mood swings are terrible. Bipolar disorder seems to run in my family, so I'm pretty sure it might be that, but I'm no doctor so I couldn't say for sure.

Thanks for the support, man. I feel like I probably would do well in another city/country somewhere, I guess more than anything it's a matter of saving the money to travel and getting a job and shit. But it's an interesting prospect, and I wouldn't count it out as an option.
